utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the thirteenth. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, you're there. Anyone see the football last night? Honestly, that second half.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Unfortunately. I'd just about stopped being annoyed, so cheers for that.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I've had traffic on the ring road to be annoyed about instead. Absolutely solid this morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely start to a Monday, then.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And the heating in the portakabin's doing its tropical setting again. I'm sat here with the door open.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: You're a bit muffled. Is your headset under your coat?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: No, scarf. There. Purely a moan about the heating, by the way, not a maintenance request.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: That's clearer. Can almost hear the heat escaping.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before we get onto what's needed, anything already closed out?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, I signed off the inspection on the GT2 on Tuesday. Last Tuesday, obviously.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's fully closed, then? Not another inspection outstanding?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Fully closed. Just keeping it out of today's list.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And I finished the repair on the Line 2 Pick and Place Robot last night. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Look at you, escaping Stores and everything.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Don't get used to it. But yes, finished, no carry-over on that repair.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: While I'm on, I heard a slight rattle from the Stretch Wrapper, nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, observation only. Not putting a job against that.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Same sort of thing here: heard a slight rattle from the line 1, nothing to action yet. Just something I noticed.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, a noise mentioned on a call isn't automatically a strip-down.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: On the blocked stuff, the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: So that remains blocked, rather than becoming work we can actually put through today.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Exactly. Status hasn't changed. I'm not adding a separate chase to this morning's actions.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the line 3 chiller. Same position there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Both still blocked, no new action coming out of those updates.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Also, we were going to replace the belt on the CV01 but that's been pushed to next month so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, that's off today's work. Not sitting there as something someone needs to pick up.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Fiona, can you sort the permit to work and isolation for the site water for tomorrow morning? That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't take that. I'm already at capacity, and I can't give the isolation side the attention it needs.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, not with Fiona, then. Grace, can you take over sorting the permit to work and isolation for the site water?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the site water for tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, just checking—you're taking both bits, not only the permit paperwork?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Both, yeah. The permit to work and the isolation. That's with me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Grace. That one's safety critical, straight away, with it sorted for tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Understood. Straight away on that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll recalibrate the sensors on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve. That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Sarah, that's you taking the recalibration itself, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll do the recalibration. I'm not handing that one round.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right. Sensors, rather than a mechanical overhaul of the valve. Easy for those to get muddled in the notes.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Recalibrate the sensors on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve, that's the scope.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Priya Raman, can you do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the relief valve at half two? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yes, I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the relief valve at half two.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Half two for the sign-off itself, rather than just starting to look at it?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: For the sign-off, yes. At half two. I've got that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. It's production-holding work, so it stays a first-priority job, not something tucked behind the routine stuff.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie, can you schedule downtime for the line 1 TCU with production on Friday? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll schedule downtime for the line 1 TCU with production on Friday.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: That's arranging the downtime, not taking on the actual maintenance as well?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Just scheduling the downtime with production. Nothing else being added to it.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Fine, that's with me. On Friday, and not an urgent one.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Okay, that makes sense. Not treating that as an urgent outage.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: There's still the pre-use checks on the Forklift Fleet. Those need doing Monday, so today. We haven't got anyone against that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anyone able to take the pre-use checks on the Forklift Fleet for Monday?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I can't commit to those, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: No, I can't take them either. Don't put my name down just because I mentioned the robot.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, understood. Nobody's taken the pre-use checks on the Forklift Fleet. Still needed Monday, still unassigned.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: One other thing I can take: I'll inspect the turbine two water valve for leaks by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Grace. That one's whenever you get a chance, by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll fit that inspection in whenever I get a chance, and have it done by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, I spoke over you there. That's the less urgent one, separate from the site water isolation?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Exactly. The site water permit and isolation is the safety-critical one, straight away. The turbine two water valve inspection is whenever I get a chance, by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. We've agreed those owners; the Forklift Fleet checks are the exception, still nobody on them. Supplier items remain blocked, and the belt replacement isn't today's work.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, that's how I've understood it. Nothing extra from the rattles either.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good. And apparently no sympathy for the football.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Absolutely none. Cheers, everyone, we'll leave it there.
